palette_rationale: Keep the reviewed 63-color pale-pink petals, black source eye marks where they survive, yellow sprout and green lower body; no speculative eye recolor.
reference: Own DSTS chr056 mesh/clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Grounded row-47 shadow. Approved Idle contains a known green below-shadow pixel and must remain byte-exact; action lift is source-native.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own alternating lower-limb and sprout bob; loop endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native upright lunge and petal/limb extension; never trim Physical Attack.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Own forward dip and flower-body spin/release; no projectile or effect.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native drooping/resting pose; do not invent eyelids if dark eye dots stay open-looking.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own sideward recoil with lower-body tilt.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native petal/leaf sweep without synthetic weapon.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual cycles of own ba02 lunge, one PMDO HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Distinct native rise/turn; no artificial vertical shift.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native swaying, winding plant-body charge with reverse-sampled recovery; no glow.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own sprout/body motion with whole-view yaw; endpoint excluded.
